roles.summary: Architecting scalable full-stack systems serving 2,000+ daily users. Building visual query builders, automated field mapping engines, and real-time analytics infrastructure with WebSockets, Redis, and React.

sections.title: Full-stack architecture
sections.body: I design and build scalable systems that serve thousands of daily users with clean, maintainable code.
bullets: Architected component-based React and React Native architecture with reusable patterns for state management and real-time data synchronization across web and mobile platforms.
Built a visual query builder with autocomplete, validation, and real-time preview — cutting query creation time by 60% and boosting user productivity by 40%.
Engineered an automated field mapping engine that resolves 50+ fields across forms and workflows using pattern matching and validation rules — eliminating ~90% of manual configuration effort.

sections.title: Real-time systems
sections.body: I developed the real-time infrastructure that powers live updates for thousands of concurrent users.
bullets: Built real-time analytics infrastructure using WebSocket streams, server-sent events, and Redis caching — delivering sub-second data updates to 2,000+ daily users at 99.9% uptime.
Optimized Workflow Builder performance with diffing algorithms and WebSocket-based synchronization for drag-and-drop interactions — achieving 30% faster rendering.
Built offline-capable React Native workflows and a shared component library spanning 3+ modules, accelerating cross-platform delivery.

sections.title: Engineering practice
bullets: Work across the full stack: from React/Next.js interfaces to Node.js/Fastify APIs to PostgreSQL/Redis data layers.
Focus on performance, reliability, and clean architecture in every component and service I build.
Write tests and review code as part of disciplined delivery practice.

roles.summary: Led a team of 3 to build a modular LMS platform, implemented JWT authentication flows, and designed UI/UX prototypes that won 1st Prize internally.

sections.title: Internship contribution
sections.body: A 6-month internship where I led frontend development for an LMS platform and delivered high-quality UI/UX work.
bullets: Led a team of 3 developers to build a modular Learning Management System from scratch.
Implemented secure JWT authentication and authorization flows.
Designed UI/UX prototypes that won 1st Prize in an internal design competition.
